about.title: San Leandro Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a death in San Leandro traces back to someone else's carelessness, the family left behind is asked to make hard decisions at the worst time. A wrongful death claim is one of those decisions. It is a civil action, separate from any criminal case the Alameda County District Attorney may pursue, and it exists so that the people who depended on the person who died can seek compensation for what was taken from them. In 2025, public records show 304 injury collisions in San Leandro, with 405 people hurt and 3 lives lost. Many clustered along I-880, Route 185, E 14th Street and Washington Avenue, and reports tended to peak on Wednesdays between 5 and 7 p.m. Behind each fatality is a household adjusting to an empty chair. LawProactive does not represent you. We are a free service that matches you with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death cases and works on contingency, so no fee is owed unless there is a recovery. You talk, they listen, and you decide whether to move forward.

whyChoose.title: What a Wrongful Death Attorney Brings to Your Family

items.title: Clarity on Who Can File
items.desc: California limits who has standing: a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children come first, followed by certain dependents and heirs. An attorney sorts out who belongs in the claim before anything is filed.

items.title: Protection of the Two-Year Window
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the deadline is much shorter when a city, county or state agency is involved. Early counsel keeps that clock from running out quietly.

items.title: A Full Accounting of the Loss
items.desc: Recoverable losses reach beyond funeral and burial costs to include lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. An attorney documents each of these so nothing is left off the table.

items.question: My family member died in a crash on I-880 in San Leandro and a government vehicle was involved. Does that change anything?
items.answer: Yes, it can change the timeline significantly. When a public entity may share responsibility, California requires a formal claim to be presented far sooner than the standard two years from the date of death. That is one reason families in San Leandro are encouraged to speak with an attorney early, even while still grieving.

items.question: The driver is being prosecuted. Do we have to wait for the criminal case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and runs on its own track, separate from anything the district attorney does. The outcome of the criminal case can matter as evidence, but it does not decide whether your family may pursue compensation, and waiting does not pause the civil filing deadline.

items.question: What does it cost to be connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service and not a law firm; we simply introduce you to an independent attorney who handles wrongful death cases in Alameda County. The attorneys in our network work on contingency, which means no attorney fee is owed unless there is a recovery.
